row.title: Slice W03 of the specification run's code and tests shipped on its own
row.body: The ghcost, governance, graph, ignorance, install and kernel modules. Tests that need files from later slices (the tools scripts, the remediation migrations, the org and bootstrap changes) ship with the last slice; the shared ratchets and ledger tests run on the final tree.
